quests.title: Shifting Moonlight

dialogue.t: The kuuhenki and I were just playing a picture-guessing game. Would you like to join?
If you'd like, you're more than welcome to play with the kuuhenki again sometime.
See if you can guess what this picture is.
Hmph, that was way too obvious!
I'm afraid this riddle was a little too simple for us.
All you need to do is guess what the picture is.

dialogue.sit: A Weasel Thief who's eaten too much.

dialogue.t: How did you manage to guess that!?
So that's what it's called. Does it pick its creator up and carry her around in its hand?
Paimon thinks you might be confusing Aino with a former colleague of yours...
All you need to do is guess what the picture is.
Did you play this with the kuuhenki before and forget to tell us?
The structures the Fatui have raised in Nod-Krai are far too... bold. Even the kuuhenki can remember them...

dialogue.sit: Once the game is over, the kuuhenki rush toward you. They appear to be extremely happy.

dialogue.t: Thank you for taking the time to play with the kuuhenki.
I hope we can have just as much fun playing together next time.

quests.description: The Damselette seems to be playing with kuuhenki in the Silvermoon Hall…
